essence: The variety of meditation and worship is effective because an embodied, divided deity can be invoked and act immediately.
The coming-and-going account is only scripturally suitable, while the formless nature is what truly fits.
Division is not external to the self but is consciousness manifesting according to its own nature.
Karmic division counts as impurity in bondage but not in the liberating use of initiation and ritual.
Initiation is essentially the true consciousness that destroys division-based transmigration.
